description: every asset should carry file:size and file:checksum
collection IDs should be lowercase [a-z0-9_-], start with a letter, and be unique
catalog and collection directories must contain AGENTS.md and README.md
AGENTS.md must be linked with rel:'agents' and type text/markdown
README.md must be linked with rel:'describedby' and type text/markdown
a collection's README.md should mention its license and data provenance
the whole tree was read, so every check could see every file
license 'other' requires a rel:'license' link to the license text
every contained object is reachable through a child or item link
structural links must resolve against the file tree to the correct object
a mirror must include a rel:'via' link (type text/html) to the original source
a mirror should link the upstream STAC with rel:'canonical' when one exists
a mirror must record sync time in a top-level RFC 3339 'updated' field
geospatial collections must include a thumbnail asset (png, jpeg or webp)
collections with a visual derivative must register style assets
PMTiles must be registered via a rel:'pmtiles' link (web-map-links v1.3.0)
